name: Katakura Industries Co.,Ltd.
summary: Katakura Industries Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the textiles, pharmaceuticals, machinery, real estate, and other businesses in Japan. It offers undergarments, hosiery products, aprons, casual wear, undergarments for seniors, and relaxing garments; and various functional fibers, such as the water-soluble fiber solvron and NITIVY ALF thermal resistant fibers, as well as David Hicks products. The company also provides pharmaceuticals for treating cardiovascular illnesses comprising Frandol for the treatment of angina pectoris; Frandol tape, a heart medicine; and Bisono tape, a ß1 blocker.
